comment: The code-review golden set (ADR 0070, Consequences). Each case is a real commit range from this repository's history in which a defect the repo later documented as an ADR incident was merged, and the finding a reviewer should have raised about it. `source` and `rule` are case-insensitive patterns because the reviewer phrases a rule in the source's words; `files` lists every path at which the same defect is fairly located. Recall is matched over expected and a case passes at or above `minRecall`. Replayed by .github/workflows/review-golden-replay.yml on every Pull Request that touches the skill, the schema, the validator, the renderer, the review workflow, or this file; scored by tools/scripts/review/score-golden-case.mjs; shape and ranges asserted by tools/scripts/check-review-golden-set.mjs. Grows by attribution: when a merged defect is traced to a review that should have caught it, its range and expected finding go here.

cases.title: A sixth VaultBlobType member is added and no hand-enumerated consumer is touched
cases.head: b9176851470821a4cad65f5290134f1882ef9ec1

expected.why: the diff added Groceries to VaultBlobType and changed no consumer; libs/web-vault/src/lib/vault/vaultMigration.ts hand-enumerated five members, so the keep-server reconcile never uploaded or compared groceries ciphertext and destroyed it (#512)

cases.title: The hardened export envelope enumerates blob types by hand and omits Tasks
cases.head: 7fde881c0a2f57d05bfc92a20c9cbb863dd52200

expected.why: envelopeFromLocalVault listed the blob types as property names and left Tasks out, so a hardened export silently dropped that blob from the day it was written (#537)

cases.title: The Tailwind preset stops emitting literal palette utilities that pages still use
cases.head: e4220d012f7fa62fcc5d8766675586bf92038f24

expected.why: the groceries pages used literal palette classes that the reshaped preset no longer emitted; Tailwind drops an unresolvable class silently, so the pages shipped unstyled (#632)
